title: All Are Welcome
author: Alexandra Penfold & Suzanne Kaufman

hero.name: Diverse classroom children (All Are Welcome)
hero.description: Group of children from many different backgrounds and cultures, as shown on the book cover
hero.source_note: Cover features a specific illustrated group of multicultural children — source a cover image or matching clip art from TPT or Creative Fabrica; generic Boardmaker 'children' icon will not match the book's distinctive art style

ambiguous.issue: Could map to core row 2 'different' (comparison concept) or to the book's theme of being different/diverse (descriptive identity)
ambiguous.reason: In this book 'different' is used thematically to mean people look and come from different places — it overlaps with the core word but is so central to the book's message it earns a fringe slot; consider using a 'diverse people' icon rather than the standard comparison arrow icon to distinguish the two uses

ambiguous.issue: Could mean a country/national flag or a generic flag shape
ambiguous.reason: The book features many different national/cultural flags representing the children's heritages; search for a world flags or multicultural flags icon

notes: This book celebrates diversity, inclusion, and belonging in a school setting. Several high-value words (school, children, teacher, classroom) are already available in activity_images and the existing aac_extras cover 'welcome' and 'together' — these have been retained in fringe_12 as they are central to the book's message and students need them accessible on this specific board. 'Different' appears in core row 2 but is so thematically important here that a second fringe instance is recommended with a culturally-diverse icon to carry the book's meaning. The 11 fringe words intentionally avoid duplicating school/classroom/teacher/book which are already in the existing activity_images set. If board space is tight, 'celebrate' could be swapped for 'culture' or 'happy'.
